outline:
透過原理解說與系統實作，使學生熟悉物件導向設計原理及C++進階程式設計技術，內容包含：
1. C++ 物件模型
2. 類別與物件
3. 建構者與解構者
4. 繼承
5. 虛擬函式與多型
6. 運算子溢載
7. 例外處理
8. 泛型程式設計
9. 標準模板程式庫
10. 期末專題設計
schedule:
Overview of Object Oriented Programming
C++ Basics
Functions, Parameters, and Overloading
Arrays, Structures and Classes
Constructors and Other Tools
Operator Overloading, Friends, and References
Strings
Pointers and Dynamic Arrays
Streams and File I/O
Inheritance
Polymorphism and Virtual Functions
Templates
Standard Template Library
Patterns and UML
(Basically, 1-2 wks per topic)
assessment:
Homework and program assignments: ~40%
Quiz: ~10-15%
Midterm: ~20-25%
Final exam: ~20-25%
materials:
【遵守智慧財產權觀念，請使用正版教科書，不得使用非法影印教科書】

使用外文原文書：

Textbook: Absolute C++, 5th edition, by Walter Savitch, Addison-Wesley, 2012. (開發)
References:
. The C++ Programming Language, 3rd edition, by Bjarne Stroustrup, Addison-Wesley, 1997.
. C++ Primer, 5th edition, by Stanley B. Lippman, Josee Lajoie, and Barbara E. Moo, Addison-Wesley, 2012.
. other online notes
Prerequisite:
. Basic computer skills (FIT-I basic)
. Working experience of high-level programming languages such as C (FIT-I pro)
